reviews.text: I Have been at this Centre with my dog over the last few days. Very friendly Doctors and staff. Appreciate their tiered triage/treatment approach. My dog’s issue took a concerning turn, and I had the full support from the entire centre.  I apologize as I’m sure I’m forgetting a few people. Special thanks to Cami (she is the most honest and compassionate person I have ever met), Hannah, Mary, Ariana. Dr. Johnson and Dr. Ocando, and one more very nice doctor, can’t remember her name. And several other kind staff.  I know my dog is in good hands. I know some reviews critique wait times. They do triage! Be nice to these people. I have seen over days what they do. They are allowed to have lunch, they are allowed to laugh. They really do care about our pets! I know it’s tough when our fur baby’s are sick. Give grace and you will get it back ten fold. :) sometimes you just have to be kind and hit the I believe button. I’m so glad my dog is here. Thank you to everyone at the Centre!! You are all top notch professionals.
I wish I could say good things, place looks well structured and well reviewed. However it ended up being just a waste of time for my case and experience
Brought my doggie who was on the brink of death to Doral Centre Animal hospital. They brought her back to life! I owe them everything!!! Thank you a million times over!
Camila was so kind with us and helpful with our sick dog, definitely she loves animals. the Vet was very professional and not only check the dog's injury but check everything of his body.
Don’t ever bring your pets here, worst hospital ever, 5 hours waiting and the billlllll
Very expensive, NOT friendly at all.
I was treated with respect, consideration and compassion given the circumstances, thanks to the entire team who assisted me.

The only star I can give this place is for the decoration and appearance of the facility. Unfortunately, based on my experience, I cannot recommend this hospital.

I brought my dog here because I believed I was dealing with an **emergency**, and I expected urgency, compassion, clear communication, and appropriate follow-up. That was not the experience I received.

I was presented with an extremely expensive proposed treatment and diagnostic plan, starting at approximately **$2,900**, with the possibility of costs increasing significantly depending on additional testing and procedures. I felt enormous pressure to approve multiple diagnostics, and when I did not agree to everything that was proposed, I felt that the attitude and level of attention toward us changed the following day.

What disappointed me the most was the lack of communication and follow-up regarding my dog's ultrasound. After taking my dog out of the hospital, I was still waiting for the results. I eventually had to **personally contact the outside company that provides the ultrasound service**. They responded to me in less than 24 hours. Meanwhile, I am **still waiting for the doctors at this hospital to contact me regarding those results**.

When someone brings a pet to an emergency hospital, they are already scared, stressed, and vulnerable. They should not have to chase down important medical information themselves or feel that the quality of attention depends on how many tests or procedures they agree to pay for.

A beautiful facility means very little without **compassion, communication, transparency, and proper follow-up**.

Unfortunately, my experience here was extremely disappointing, and I would not bring my dog back.

They took exceptional care of not one, but two of my dogs. Most recently this past weekend, my dog was suffering a life-threatening emergency, and this team got him back to his normal self within days. I cannot thank them enough for giving me more time with my pup

We brought our beloved Bella to this clinic after being referred for a mammary tumor and possible surgery. During the visit they performed a cytology, an invasive procedure, without first checking her coagulation. Afterwards, she began bleeding internally. When i expressed concern about the bleeding, i was told that i was normal and to bring her back if she kept bleeding. It was not normal. Her condition progressed into a serious coagulation problem that required hospitalization and two platelet transfusions. I strongly believe that failing to evaluate her coagulation before procedure, followed by dismissing her continued bleeding contributed to what happened. What was even more disturbing happened with her transfusions. The morning after her first platelet transfusion, approximately six hours had passed and the second transfusion had still not been started because we had not yet paid for it. We had to physically go to the office and make the payment, they had 6 hours to let us know. Treatment was delayed due to pending payments. Despite everything she had just gone through, the clinic later contacted us about scheduling her surgery rather than first asking how she was, also she has a coagulation problem and you are calling us about surgery? We ended up losing her a couple of days after all of this , we were heartbroken questioning about whether what happened could hav been avoided. We were stunned also by the lack of compassion afterwards. Other vets offices that knew her, reached out when they learned she had passed, but we never received a condolence call, card, or acknowledge from this clinic. Im sharing our experience so other pet owners know this place cares more about their profits and than their actual patients.

We had a emergency with our old doggy and we went at 2:00 am , every one was so nice and they did everything possible to save my old doggy Star was her name but my family and I are really thankful for every one there the employees at the emergency we will always be grateful to every one thank you. From family Orozco

My dog was on cancer meds. He needed staples removed from a fight. After we got him back from the first sedation I noticed that they missed several staples. Doctor recommended we sedate him again not even two hours after the first sedation. When I got home he started having explosive black diarrhea. They instructed that we had to remove him from the cancer medication because it was causing ulcers. This led to him dying sooner because we could not give him the proper care. weather the over sedation was what caused the problem or not I am still incredibly disappointed at the fact they could not remove staples the first time and missed more than three. I would only take dogs here for emergencies. RIP boogie. Staff and some doctors were amazing with my dog but the last doctor was careless.

Took my dog yesterday for ear infection. It took over 2.5 hours! They also came in with the highest cost estimate without providing options. I had to decline a once-administered $180 medication and asked for drops that I administer (saving $80) and declined the ear cleaning as her ears were just cleaned (saving $50). Then I find that the med and the ear cleaner they provided are available thru Chewy and/or Amazon at a fraction of what they charged. The bill was almost $300. It's unfortunate since I thought they were very reasonable when I first went to them at their older location. Now it just seems to be $$$

Avoid this place

I brought my dog to Doral Centre Animal Hospital for an emergency, but we waited a long time without a veterinarian examining him. The doctor didn't even turn to look at my dog, yet we still paid for the visit I guess just to get an estimate. Instead, he began preparing an estimate based only on what we had explained, and we received no clear information about when blood work or treatment would begin.

When we expressed our concern about the delay, we were told, “if you go to a people hospital, you have to wait five hours.” I found this response inappropriate and lacking compassion, especially since my dog had been vomiting and we were worried about dehydration.

I understand emergency hospitals can be busy, but the lack of timely evaluation and communication was extremely disappointing. Based on this experience, I cannot recommend Doral Centre Animal Hospital and will not be returning.
I left one star because otherwise I couldn't leave the review, they don't deserve any stars or being in business.

I truly cannot say enough good things about this hospital and the care we received. I brought my dog in after an incredibly frightening emergency, and from the moment I walked in, the front desk team immediately recognized the urgency and acted without hesitation. Their compassion and incredibly fast response meant more to me than I can express.

Dr. Gutierrez was phenomenal, thorough, attentive, compassionate, and reassuring while still taking the situation very seriously. This is exactly the kind of team you hope is there when something goes wrong with an animal you love. I’m incredibly grateful and would recommend this hospital without hesitation.
Pia is a wonderful person, very professional, and provides amazing customer service! <3

I just wanted to take a moment to say how incredibly grateful we are for cami and the care she gave us during our visit to the veterinarian. From the moment we met her, she was so kind, patient, and genuinely caring. She made us feel comfortable right away, and she took the time to answer every single one of our questions without ever making us feel rushed or like we were bothering her. You could truly tell that she cared about us and, most importantly, about Lupita. We truly could not have asked for a better person to be there for us that day. Cami was absolutely amazing, and her kindness and professionalism made such a positive impression on us. We are incredibly thankful for everything she did. 🖤

I'm extremely upset with the level of follow-up here. I have spent close to $1000 with Doral Centre Animal Hospital in hopes they could tell me why my cat will not eat. They scare you into thinking that without all their charges, the cat will die! Then they complete another test, send you home without any further instruction, leaving you to believe that, hmm, perhaps he won't die, but the cat is still not eating. You call to speak with the Vet to seek next best steps and they advertise it will take up to 48 hours and you're now approaching hour 96 and you haven't gotten a call back. So what is the real deal? Are you concerned about the cat or about padding your pockets for your brand new facility? Very disappointing! The fact that there is no call back makes me believe, the situation is not as grave as is being charged!!!!!
We have been using the Doral Centre Animal Hospital for 14 years. The staff are true animal lovers. They are patient and kind to the animals and the "parents".   We love the new facility!

I wanted to write this review because so many vet clinics are very money hungry & this is a perfect example of one. The night that we went to this clinic was for an emergency, we found a stray cat on the street who got ran over & we brought the cat in because it was the only place open overnight. The receptionist as well as the assistants were amazing. The service we got from the rest of the staff was incredible, they truly made it possible to feel calm about the animals medical emergency. They explained everything clearly & tried to help us with financing & treatment. The problem was the doctor on night shift, she was completely unhelpful, she wouldn’t give us any bit of insight on the animals quality of life. She wouldn’t give us straightforward answers without paying for more tests & we payed $300 for the doctor to come in & give us a “consultation” the consultation consisted of the doctor coming in, telling us the cat will live & not being able to answer ANY of our questions without racking up a good enough bill. She truly ruined our experience there, we left there feeing unsatisfied & ripped off.

All they care about is your money not the animals trust me go anywhere else but here they are all horrible people the staff should all be fired and closed down I have 5 dogs and 4 cats and I will never bring my babies here THEY DONT CARE

I had a very disappointing experience here. I brought my dog in because I was genuinely concerned, but instead of properly evaluating him first, I felt immediately judged and poorly spoken to over something that had not even been 100% confirmed through testing. I’m choosing to leave and take my dog to another vet. At this point, I don’t care what the cost is. I will not support a business that makes me feel uncomfortable, judged, and disrespected when I’m simply trying to get help for my dog.

UPDATE: I took Bear to another veterinary hospital where we were treated with kindness, professionalism, and compassion. Most importantly, they listened to me and took Bear’s previous medical history seriously.

I was told that Bear was experiencing hypoglycemia (low blood sugar), which explained the severe weakness he was experiencing. This was also not the first time Bear has had an episode like this. We later realized he had not been eating properly, which was especially concerning given his history of low blood sugar.

What continues to upset me about my experience at Doral Centre Animal Hospital is how quickly drug exposure was presented to me as the explanation for Bear’s condition before testing had confirmed it. I repeatedly tried to explain his history and what had happened to him previously, but I did not feel heard. One of the doctors went as far as telling me that, based on his “gut,” he believed it was drugs.

I was also presented with an approximately $3,000 treatment/diagnostic estimate while feeling like the information I was giving about my own dog was being dismissed.

I understand that veterinarians have to consider different possibilities in an emergency, including toxin exposure. My issue is not that it was considered—my issue is the way I felt it was treated as a conclusion before it had been confirmed and the way I felt judged in the process.

As a mother, business owner, and responsible pet owner, the experience was extremely upsetting and uncomfortable. I came in terrified and looking for help for my dog, not to feel accused or judged.

Thankfully, I trusted my instincts, sought another veterinary opinion, and Bear received care in an environment where I felt listened to and respected. Based on my personal experience, I cannot recommend this hospital, and I will not be returning.

Horrible. No feelings. No emotions. Brought my sphinx cat this morning there. He had issues with breathing. They took him in the back. We went in a room without my cat. Honestly, it felt like they held my cat hostage. A lady came said he had  issues breathing. And heart issues.Cold as ice. Said that he needed to stay  and get an echo. And overnight. For the.next three days and some other lab works. $5000 later. If you love your dogs or cats. Don’t take them there. This place is a butcher shop. Nightmare. It should be closed down.🥲 One more thing. The young girl in the front. Who was half asleep. On her laptop. Only talking about the charges and the cost. Not about the Solucion for my cat. Disgraceful. Unethical. Needs to be closed down. A meat market.🥲
Camila was my dogs nurse and she was extremely warm,caring, and informative. We could not have asked for better care. Thank you to all the staff!

"If your pet is sick and needs urgent care, 'Do not go to this place.' My pet had 5 episodes of vomiting and 8 episodes of diarrhea, and they made me wait an hour because there was only one doctor available. After an hour, they 'kindly' suggested I go somewhere else if I was in a hurry."

Terrible service we was there for 2 hours seating at the room no body show up or give us any explanation ! They not even coming and say dr will be with you guys soon ! They was talking and have fun at the front desk ! They charge me every time I go there with my dog and they can’t give me a good service ?? He’ll Noooo !
Visited there for my cat Luci's FAVN test, all staff were great and very helpfull, Thank you All❤️🙏 …
Thank you for your positive review - we appreciate you taking the time and can't wait to see you again!
They were great!

I highly recommend Dr. Arana and Nurse Hector. While my pet was seen at an urgent care visit, they allowed me time to explain the incident and concerns. Nurse Hector quite literally went through my dog’s vomit to locate the material. They were professional, provided education, and performed necessary tests to ensure my Thor’s wellness was good. They answered all my questions and as a result I will be transferring services based on our first visit. Thankful for everyone’s compassion and patience!

From the moment I called, the entire team went above and beyond for my dog. Their communication was exceptional, they always kept me informed, returned my calls promptly, and even followed up by email to make sure I had everything I needed. It’s clear that everyone genuinely cares about both their patients and their owners. I truly appreciated how attentive, kind, and responsive they were throughout the entire process. I couldn’t have asked for better service or care for my dog. I highly recommend this animal hospital to!

Without a doubt, the service was 1000/100. From the moment we arrived, everything was very quick and the staff showed so much love to all the animals that came in. The doctor and the whole team were wonderful. I recommend it one thousand percent ❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️

This level of service and lack of response at a 24-hour emergency veterinary clinic is completely unacceptable. My sister waited from 12:00 a.m. until 2:00 a.m. without a veterinarian ever showing up. In my case, I tried calling and was left on hold for over an hour with no answer. I called more than five times and no one ever responded.
This kind of negligence and disorganization is unacceptable for a facility that claims to provide 24-hour emergency care, where pets require immediate attention. The lack of staff, communication, and responsiveness puts animals’ lives at risk and reflects a highly unprofessional level of care. This does not meet even the basic standards expected from an emergency veterinary service.

In case of emergencies I highly recommend this place, I had to take my corgi at 1 am cause he had a marrow bone stuck in his lower jaw and the staff was super welcoming and did a great job, it was literally an in-and-out thing, no wait time and super efficient ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
Excellent customer service

Karla and the staff at the Doral clinic were such sweethearts with our dog Legend, poor baby had an ear infection and they cleaned his ears and taught us how to properly do it, they were incredibly patient and offered different payment plans as well! Highly recommend this place and huge shoutout to the front desk team absolutely amazing and attentive
We are sorry to see you had a negative experience and would love the opportunity to learn more. Please contact us directly to ensure any outstanding issues are resolved.
Front desk clerk  lady on sunday june 28th very unprofessional, hangs up the call and cant awnser basic questions

I am so grateful to have found this center; from the moment I arrived, they handled my emergency with speed and genuine compassion. The team was always attentive and ready to help, answering all my questions. I was able to visit my pet whenever I wanted and whenever I could. I am especially grateful to Dr. Rodriguez and Milly for their care, as well as the entire staff. Thank God my Lola is recovering, and we feel much more relieved.

Stay away from this place. They took advantage of my emergency and tried to charge me almost $2,000 for my dog’s allergic reaction. When I pushed back, the price magically dropped to $900, then $500. I ended up paying $190 for a visit where the vet barely touched my dog, plus $30 for basic allergy meds.

Once they realized they weren’t going to get the money they wanted from me, the staff became rude, cold, and completely unempathetic , they didn’t even bother to say goodbye. This felt like a money grab, not veterinary care. Do NOT bring your pet here.
Amazing staff! Everyone was so warm, kind, and helpful from the moment we walked in. You can tell they truly care about their patients. I highly recommend them!

Truly so grateful for this hospital! My dog Cookie ate poison and I decided to took him to this health center because it was late at night and I will be forever grateful of their kindness and the professionalism of Dr. Moy.
Thank you so much for making sure my baby was safe and healthy.

I would never again. Let my puppy be seen by Dr. Margaret Johnson.\n Wow, I came in. The stuff was nice, caring for my puppy, but once the actual doctor came and talked to us, her vibe was completely off before we left, she kicked my dog in the face All because he was trying to leave the room.\n When she came in.
I didn't actually do anything that can help us in this very serious and scary situation. I wouldn't recommend anybody to let this doctor care for your pet.

I went today for a follow up with Dr. Brandon Cochran
Him and his team were gentle with my puppy and actually took care for him and made sure to cheack every possibility of what could have been happening with my baby  they were really professional and caring and I’m 1000 times greatful to have had Dr. Brandon Cochran as our veterinarian for this stressful situation

Hi, my name is Signorino, and I’m a very grateful Goldendoodle!
Thank you, Doctor Vega and Doctor Paola Vasquez, for giving me a new life and a new opportunity to enjoy every day to the fullest. Your knowledge, dedication, and compassionate care made all the difference in my journey to recovery.
A very special thank you to my amazing nurse, Betsie. During my two days with you, you cared for me with so much love and kindness that I can honestly say we created a friendship for life. You made me feel safe, comfortable, and loved when I needed it most.
I will never forget the wonderful care I received from all of you. Thank you for helping me wag my tail again and enjoy many more happy adventures ahead!
With lots of love and gratitude,
Signorino 🐶❤️
Pía was so sweet and helpful when we brought our princess who was having convulsions.   She explained everything with such care and comfort.  Appreciate her so much ❤️

Yesterday I walked into here knowing I might have to possibly make the hardest decision of my life. Thank you to Dr. Vega for being so empathetic and understanding and answering all my questions and walking us through every step at my own pace. I did ultimately have to say goodbye to my girl 😔 but thank you to Dr.Vega, student Dr Leslie and to the vet tech Betsy for being there to make me feel supported and the careful care they took of my Leah while this was going on. I’ve been to doral vet for many things and have always had a great experience but never for something like this and I’m glad I did because I don’t know if it would have been so comforted in the idea that the right decision was made, anywhere else. Thank you guys again for all you do.

Wow!!! 5 stars. They helped like no other. I needed to fly my puppy and American Airlines was making my life impossible with last minute out of nowhere requirements. The team at Doral Vet Centre was able to help thru the whole process and we were able to fly the dog with all the out of nowhere requirements.

My fiancé checked in at 3AM with my dog to be told 30 minutes later that the doctor had 14 dogs checked in and could not see my dog so they told her to leave. This place is incredibly unprofessional will never be coming here and do not recommend coming here to anyone. We later came in the morning around 9 and this staff was so attentive and apologetic. The overnight staff is terrible, the morning staff is great.

Today I took the time to visit this hospital because it's quite close to my house, and I've been wanting to go for days to ask for information and an estimate for a routine checkup for my dog, who just turned 7. As I understand it, it's a special checkup for dogs entering adulthood, and one of the girls at the front desk (the first one you see after the entrance with the colorful hair) who attended to me was incredibly incompetent. When she attended to me, she told me she wasn't authorized to give me an estimate because I had to bring my dog ​​in for a consultation, and that only then, during the consultation, could the doctor tell me how much it would cost. She said that's how it is everywhere in Miami (as if I'd never been to another clinic). On top of that, she had a terrible attitude—not empathetic, not friendly, not professional at all. She was a bitter woman who shouldn't be in charge of reception at a place like this, where people are supposed to bring their pets in emergencies or when they're sick. Fortunately, that wasn't my case, but this girl should definitely be removed from her position. She was very rude and bitter; I think she was having a very bad day. A person with that bad attitude shouldn't work in a place like this. My experience was awful…

I want to sincerely thank everyone who helped my baby pass away in the most peaceful and painless way possible. We brought our dog in knowing he was in critical condition and that he would not be coming back home with us. Every person who cared for him and for us showed so much compassion, kindness, and patience during one of the hardest moments of our lives.

The beautiful letter we received after getting his ashes brought tears to my eyes and meant more than words can express. Thank you for making one of the most painful days of our lives feel so meaningful and memorable. We will never forget the love and care you showed our family.

Highly recommend ❤️
Dr Vazquez and staff are so professional, kind, and attentive. I recommend this clinic 1000000 percent

The absolute best hospital for your fur babies!! Forever grateful for saving my baby Louise. Sending text message updates and photos of her while hospitalized meant the world to me. The team is amazing and so very kind every step of the way and the hospital is impecable.
Dr. Vega and Dr. Vazquez were excellent. Megan was also excellent.

.This was one of the worst emergency vet experiences I’ve ever had. I brought my dog in around midnight in severe pain, and I felt that no real attempt was made to examine or stabilize him before discussing expensive hospitalization and MRI options. I understand advanced diagnostics can be necessary, but my main concern that night was getting my dog some immediate pain relief until he could see his regular veterinarian the next morning.
Watching my dog suffer while feeling dismissed was extremely upsetting. I expected more compassion, communication, and basic emergency care.I do not recommend this clinic because I did not feel there was genuine compassion or care for animals. As a pet owner facing an emergency situation, I expected more empathy, concern, and sensitivity toward my dog’s suffering.I left feeling that financial profit was a bigger priority than genuinely helping and relieving my dog’s suffering.

On a scale of 1 to 10, my rating is 20.
Exceptional, wonderful—first-rate care from the very moment you walk through the door. I only wish that healthcare facilities for humans provided the same level of care that you doExceptional, wonderful—first-rate care from the very moment you walk through the door. I only wish healthcare centers for humans offered the kind of care that you do.

They've been great, they've treated my dog ​​twice in emergencies and everything went very well. They explain everything in the best way and our dog comes out okay, which is the most important thing 🙏 …

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ 5 Stars… is that all I can give?? I would gladly give 100 stars if I could! I’m in Doral for work for a few weeks as I live in Atlanta. My German Shepherd developed a slight limp and I thought maybe she split or cracked one of her toe nails. A friend told me she takes her dog to Doral Centre Animal Hospital and highly recommended them. I called, that greeted me and all the ladies flocked to my girl , gave her some love and they got me right in and saw my girl immediately. Inspected her nails, paw pads and feet. There was nothing visible that they could see wrong with her. Gave me advice on trimming her nails and care for her feet and didn’t charge me! I was in shock! Everyone I encountered… EVERYONE was extremely nice and helpful. They truly care about your animals. I travel to Miami from time to time and if I ever need veterinary care again, I will be bringing my girl here without any hesitation! Thank you, Doral Centre Animal Hospital!
Amazing staff! My dog loves them!

They saved my cat here before, but I took a female cat in, and the doctor, who only speaks English, brought a young woman who explained the situation to me. After the test results came back, the doctor returned with another nurse who speaks Spanish, but this time he didn't explain anything to me. He explained it to a friend of mine who helped me pay the cat's bill. He didn't say a word to me this time; he just got up, turned his back, and left. I was stunned. How could this guy who works there as a doctor just get up and leave as if I were a dead weight? I was speechless. There were things he didn't tell me but told my friend, who doesn't live with me. Just because I have someone who helped me pay the vet bill doesn't mean you can discriminate against me for not speaking fluent English. If I go back to the hospital with another animal, I won't accept you as my doctor. I'll ask for someone else to treat me. I paid; it's none of your business how or who helped me. I chose that hospital, and I'm the one who put food on your table! Update: The cat has gingivitis, among other things, and I told the nurse that if they had to clean her mouth, they should do it. The doctor just gave her a mouthwash for the gingivitis and a Capstar, nothing for the cat's pain and inflammation. He also didn't tell me what food the cat should eat. It was all awful.
Overpriced

This is an emergency hospital, not a standard clinic. They will ask for payment info and a deposit before treatment begins. Unless it is a critical emergency, I highly recommend getting a cost estimate as soon as you arrive. Emergency surgeries here can easily outpace the cost of a car. If you’re prone to making emotional decisions, bring a friend who can help you stay grounded regarding the costs.

They have been amazing every single time, whether an emergency or routine visit, the care, attention and professionalism have been outstanding. I feel so safe leaving my dogs in their care. Could not be more satisfied with the service , from frontline to clinical staff. Highly recommend it.

I would like to say “Thank you” to all the staff from the receptionist at the front desk to the Veterinarian and assistants. I truly appreciate your professionalism, honesty, and sympathy throughout such a difficult time and decision. It wasn’t the outcome we wanted but it was only fair for our beloved 15 year old Bella to earn her wings. This place felt wholesome and full of love and peace. We appreciate you and highly recommend your place without any doubt's. Once again Thank You!❤️🐶🐾
The personal was very helpful. It was very expensive.
Candy Arias, excellent service, thank you.

I’ve been here with both my dogs and my cat throughout the years.. through their ER service, urgent care service, and having an appt for something simple. Each time they’ve been amazing. From the front desk, to the techs who have all been great especially Christina with my Zoey. I’ve seen several vets while there and they’ve all been awesome but Dr. Burke and most recently Dr.V who sent an email after the appointment with instructions on how to care for my dogs skin issue have been the best. Recently my dog had to stay overnight after a surgery, and they had someone send updates and pictures through text in the evening and early morning which was such a relief during my anxiety of having her hospitalized. I fully trust them with my babies and appreciate all they’ve done for them.

On the night of March 16–17, my dog was hospitalized in critical condition, and my experience with the front desk was very upsetting. When I called to get clarification from the doctor about her lab results, the receptionist responded in an unprofessional and dismissive manner. I understand the doctor was busy with other emergencies, but her attitude lacked basic compassion during an incredibly stressful moment.
Tragically, my dog passed away just two hours later, which shows how serious the situation was. I called again the following day hoping for some clarity or comfort, as the results were inconclusive, and asked for the doctor to return my call. I never received a response.
It’s deeply disappointing that during such a difficult time, there was such a lack of sensitivity and communication.

I came in at 2 in the morning with my pregnant cat that unfortunately wasn’t being able to give birth to her kittens and was in very weak condition and they attended her super fast and helped her in less than 10 minutes deliver her baby, very nice and gentle care here i completely recommend this place to anybody with a pet in need, Ruben at the front was so sweet and helpful, they even offer payment plans, just amazing I’m so thankful I chose to come here before anywhere else, thank you so much for all the care.

I am so thankful for the staff all around for their great service and attention. They saved my pomsky Cash’s life. The staff was truly amazing, quick and attentive to all of Cash’s needs. Thank you guys and I recommend this hospital for any pet services you may need
Excellent care for the animals and a super clean place for them, a very dedicated team focused on animal health, very attentive, thank you so much!!!

I had to take my precious Gaby who was almost 16 years old and was having seizures.... I knew I had to let her go and I am so grateful for how compassionate and wonderful the staff and Dr. Elizabeth Rodriguez were at such a difficult moment!  🙏 …

The most traumatic experience of my life—thanks to this place, if it can even be called a hospital.

My 8-year-old female pug passed away after being given two injections that her body could not tolerate, without any prior blood work being performed. She had undergone surgery for pyometra just three weeks earlier, and we made sure to inform them of her full medical history. Despite this, they proceeded to administer extremely strong medications.

Within hours, we had to rush back because she could no longer walk, drink water, or even relieve herself. She urinated on herself and was in critical condition. They were able to stabilize her—but only because of a situation caused by their own negligence.

What was even more shocking was the lack of basic compassion. They didn’t even have the decency to clean her before sending her back home. They simply returned her in that condition, while still expecting us to pay a high bill for something that directly harmed her.

It is completely irresponsible to administer strong opioids to an 8-year-old dog, especially one that is only three weeks post-surgery, without running any prior tests to assess her condition. On top of that, they sent us home with additional sedatives, fully aware of how strong these medications were.

We were given no proper guidance regarding her care or nutrition afterward.

And perhaps the most painful part: once they realized we could not afford the treatment they were suggesting, their attitude became cold, dismissive, and completely lacking in empathy—as if her life didn’t matter.

I understand that in medicine nothing can be known with certainty without testing, but that is exactly why it is negligent to administer such aggressive treatment without first evaluating the patient’s condition.

Today, my dog is gone. What remains is pain, frustration, and the certainty that this could have been avoided.
Thank you for your positive review - we appreciate you taking the time and can't wait to see you again!

It was a terrible experience bringing my Chihuahua there; he didn't receive the care he needed. They placed him on oxygen in a cage that barely held any air—it had gaps where the oxygen kept leaking out—and they gave him an injection of furosemide. They ended up completely dehydrating him. All of this happened simply because he was a 16-year-old dog. He was already undergoing another treatment, and they could have saved him. Run—get away from that place! Do not take your pets there... please!! 💔💔

My dog Mufasa is already quite old, and last week I brought him to this clinic. They helped him recover from pancreatitis, when at Banfield Doral they had practically given up on him.

From my experience, the care here is excellent. Dr. V was incredibly kind and gentle with my dog while explaining his diagnosis to me step by step. Her assistant Karla was also wonderful—very attentive with the administrative details and very patient in explaining the clinic’s health plans.

Thank you both so much for your care and attention.

I did have to return the next day because the cleaning of an ear infection hadn’t been done properly. However, another doctor (whose name I unfortunately don’t remember) took care of it perfectly. I’m very grateful to her as well.

Overall, I truly appreciate the kindness and professionalism of the staff.

I just left this place after being here for half an hour without being seen. I would not recommend this hospital. The service and attention were not good.
